questions.label: Slots
questions.title: How deep are the rectangular slots? (one answer for all of them)
questions.detail: The 4 openings measured 7.28 x 2.62 mm. A camera cannot see how far down they go.
questions.hint: Push the depth rod of your calipers into a slot until it touches the bottom.

friendly.detail: Those 4 openings are 7.28 x 2.62 mm. They're all the same, so just measure one! Video can't see how deep they go.
friendly.hint: Stick your caliper depth rod in a slot till it hits the bottom.
friendly.title: How deep are the 4 little slots?

questions.label: Lock ridge
questions.title: How far does the lock ridge stand out from the wall it is on?
questions.hint: Rest the depth rod on the wall beside the ridge; measure to its top.

friendly.detail: We saw about 2.0 mm in 7 front views.
friendly.hint: Sit the thin rod on the wall next to the ridge, then read to its top!
friendly.title: How much does the little lock ridge stick out?

questions.label: Lock ridge
questions.title: How wide is the lock ridge at its base?
questions.hint: Close the outside jaws across the ridge where it meets the wall.

friendly.detail: Measure right where it meets the wall.
friendly.hint: Close the big outer jaws across the ridge at the wall.
friendly.title: How wide is the little lock ridge at the bottom?

questions.label: Lock ridge
questions.title: How long is the lock ridge (end to end)?
questions.hint: Close the outside jaws over its two ends.

friendly.detail: Measure the lock ridge from one end to the other.
friendly.hint: Close the big jaws over both ends.
friendly.title: How long is the little ridge?

questions.label: Lock ridge
questions.title: What shape is the top of this bump?
questions.hint: Look along it from one end: square (box), rounded, or a hill that narrows to the top.

friendly.detail: Just pick the one that looks closest to you!
friendly.hint: Look along it from one end: flat like a box, smooth and rounded, or narrow like a hill top.
friendly.title: What shape is the top of this little bump?

questions.label: Lock ridge
questions.title: What does the top of the lock ridge look like?
questions.detail: No frame shows the ridge end-on, so its top is an estimate until you say.
questions.hint: Look along the ridge from one end.

friendly.detail: We can't see it head-on yet, so this is just our best guess.
friendly.hint: Try looking along the ridge from the end.
friendly.title: What shape is the top of the lock ridge?

questions.label: Flat plate
questions.title: How thick is the flat plate, measured in its middle?
questions.detail: The video measured 1.5 mm between the plate's faces.
questions.hint: Use the outside jaws in the middle of the plate, not at its edge.

friendly.detail: The video showed about 1.5 mm between its flat faces.
friendly.hint: Use the outside jaws in the middle, not on the edge!
friendly.title: How thick is the flat plate?
